store.description: The 1996 gothic action RPG, ported to the browser. Pick a warrior, rogue or sorcerer and descend through the cathedral beneath Tristram, clearing the labyrinth one floor at a time.
features: Three classes with their own stats and play styles
Procedurally generated cathedral floors, loot and monsters
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
